title: Returned-Payment Fee Charged on a Kestrel Auto Finance Contract
content:
**Fee clause.** On Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts, a returned-payment fee is charged once for each borrower payment the borrower's bank returns, as a returned-payment fee entry dated the assessment date that names the returned payment and the installment it was made for; a returned-payment fee not charged on the date of the return is charged on the date it is assessed. The returned-payment fee is the tier's returned-payment fee, rounded to the cent. A returned-payment fee is never below zero, and its rounding to the cent is the last step in forming it.

## Elements

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Occasion | a borrower payment returned by the borrower's bank |
| How many | one fee per returned payment |
| Entry | dated the assessment date; names the returned payment and the installment it was made for |
| Date when charged later than the return | the date it is assessed |
| Amount | the tier's returned-payment fee, rounded to the cent; never below zero |

The tier's returned-payment fee is 25.00 at every tier on the servicing fee schedule.

## Hypothetical cases

- A borrower payment made for the 2026-03-01 installment is returned by the bank on 2026-03-06 and the fee is charged that day: one entry dated 2026-03-06, naming that payment and the 2026-03-01 installment, for 25.00.
- The same return, with the fee charged on 2026-03-20: the entry is dated 2026-03-20, for 25.00.
- Two different payments returned: two fees, one naming each payment.
